svg.title: Tejal Goyal
svg.desc: Tejal Goyal (@tejalgoyal2). Software engineer. I build AI agents, data pipelines, and things that are fun to use. Latest push: portfolio: the lead files are simply on the page, their dog-ears folding down now and then and lying flat again; In brief is explained like I'm 5, said once in red pen; the ways to reach me are plainly printed.
